name: Bullshit (I Doubt It)
summary: Play cards face-down into a pile while declaring ranks. Call Bullshit if you spot a lie!

instructions: Cards are played face-down onto the center stack in sequential rank order (Aces, 2s, 3s...). Bluff when you don't have the rank! If anyone calls Bullshit, reveal the cards — a liar takes the pile, otherwise the caller takes it. First out wins.
openingNarration: Bullshit ready. Deal the full deck and prepare your best poker face!
